meta.name: run-train
meta.description: Rigor Train skill for deep learning research repositories. Use when a documented or selected training command should be run conservatively for startup verification, short-run verification, full kickoff, or resume, with command, config, seed, log, checkpoint, status, and metric evidence written to standardized `train_outputs/`. Do not use for environment setup, exploratory sweeps, speculative idea implementation, or end-to-end orchestration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把深度学习训练跑起来,并留存日志、检查点与指标
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手里有深度学习训练仓库,想让每次训练都跑得可复现、可查证。
copy.tagline_en: Run deep learning training with logs, checkpoints, and metrics saved
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a deep learning repo and want every training run reproducible and auditable

howto.what: 装好后，你指定好训练命令，它就会保守地跑起来（启动验证、短跑验证、正式开跑或断点续训），并把命令、配置、随机种子、日志、检查点、状态和指标写进 train_outputs/ 目录。
howto.when: 当你已选定训练命令，需要启动验证、短跑验证或正式开跑等保守执行时触发；环境搭建、纯推理或评估任务不适用。

say.text: 用 run-train 跑一次启动验证，只跑几步确认能起来。
say.note: 会生成 train_outputs/ 下的命令与日志。

say.text: 按当前配置正式开跑训练，把日志、检查点和指标都记录下来。
say.note: 会写入状态、日志与检查点记录。

say.text: 从上次的检查点续训，并更新 train_outputs/ 里的状态。

howto.what_en: Once installed, it conservatively runs the training command you selected — startup check, short run, full kickoff, or resume — and writes commands, configs, seeds, logs, checkpoints, status, and metrics to train_outputs/.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a training command is already selected and you want startup verification, short-run verification, full kickoff, or resume; not for env setup, inference-only, or sweeps.

say_en.text: Run a startup verification with run-train: a few steps to confirm it starts.
say_en.note: Writes commands and logs under train_outputs/.

say_en.text: Kick off full training with the current config and log checkpoints and metrics.
Resume from the last checkpoint and update the status in train_outputs/.
